name: Chicago Metro History Day
what_you_do: Students pick a topic that fits the yearly theme and research it like a historian. Then they make a website, show, film, paper or exhibit. Volunteers judge the projects at yearly contests in the Chicago area.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 6 to 12 in the Chicago metro area, guided by a teacher. The Senior Division is grades 9 to 12.
pay_detail: No fee or pay stated on the pages read
duration: School-year project; 2027 regional contest on Feb 27 (Senior Division, grades 9 to 12) at UIC Student Center East
deadline_text: 2027 theme: Innovation in History. Teacher intent form due Dec 1, 2026. Student project registration due Feb 10, 2027; upload due Feb 17, 2027. Regional contest Feb 27, 2027 (grades 9-12). Junior Division (grades 6-8) Mar 6, 2027. National contest June 13-17, 2027.
how_to_apply: Work through your teacher: the teacher files the Intent to Participate form, your school registers, then you register your project in zFairs. See the Dates and Deadlines page.
notes: School-based, so you need a teacher or school to sign up. Dates are subject to change, the museum says. The museum congratulates students on results at Illinois State History Day and National History Day. Not a job; good for building research and speaking skills.
